Cognición en Movimiento es un modelo tra: Cognición en Movimiento (Cognition in Motion) is a translational, interdisciplinary model that originated at the School of Rehabilitation Sciences of Universidad Andrés Bello. It turns the evidence on cognitively enriched physical activity into programs that are designed, implemented, and evaluated in real-world settings.
Su base conceptual articula tres marcos: Its conceptual foundation brings together three complementary frameworks. Embodied cognition holds that thinking and learning happen through the body in action and in interaction with the environment, which makes movement a legitimate pathway to learning. Cognitive load theory guides how the challenge is dosed, so that each task is demanding without exceeding the processing capacity of the person performing it. Because no task happens in isolation from its context, the model also draws on comprehensive approaches such as Whole School, Whole Community, Whole Child, which recognize that learning also depends on health and on the opportunities provided by family, institution, and community.
Cognición en Movimiento extiende esta mi: Cognición en Movimiento extends this comprehensive view beyond the school. It has been applied in early childhood, at school age, and with adults, including military personnel.
Su propósito es integrar cognición y mov: Its purpose is to integrate cognition and movement in the places where people learn, work, and perform, in order to strengthen the processes that sustain learning throughout life.
Planificar, recordar una regla que cambi: Planning, remembering a rule that changes, holding back an impulse, or deciding in a split second.
Estas capacidades, conocidas como funcio: These abilities, known as executive functions, are linked to learning and can be stimulated through physical activity when tasks are designed for that purpose.

La pregunta que guía el modelo: The question that guides the model
¿Cómo aprovechamos los beneficios de la: How can we harness the benefits of physical activity to boost cognition, social-emotional well-being, learning, and performance in real-world settings?
Nuestra respuesta se apoya en tres princ: Our answer rests on three design principles present in every program.
La tarea es el objeto de diseño. Integra: The task is what we design. It integrates both dimensions so that the cognitive challenge is required to solve the motor action, and it defines what the person must decide, remember, inhibit, and adjust while performing it.
El movimiento por sí solo no basta. Lo d: Movement alone is not enough. What matters is the cognitive challenge built into the activity, adjusted to each participant's level.
Cada sesión incluye un análisis metacogn: Every session includes a guided metacognitive review of one's own performance and, when appropriate, of the group's performance.

Cognición en Movimiento assesses and trains these abilities with tools and protocols adapted to the demands of each setting.

¿Funciona en cursos numerosos?: Does it work with large classes?
Sí. Las actividades se diseñan para el c: Yes. Activities are designed for the whole class, with simple instructions and clear rules from the start. Students can work at their desks, in pairs, or in groups that take turns, so the whole class takes part even in a small room.
¿Qué espacio y materiales se necesitan?: What space and materials are needed?
Basta con la sala de clases habitual y m: The regular classroom and low-cost materials, such as balls, cards, or cones, are enough, and they can be adapted to each setting. No special facilities are required.
¿Cómo mantener el orden cuando todos se: How do I keep order when everyone is moving?
El orden se planifica con normas explíci: Order is planned through explicit rules, a sequence the class can see, a preview of what comes next, and careful transitions between movement and desk work. With practice, students learn the routine.
¿Debo modificar mis planificaciones?: Do I need to change my lesson plans?
No. Es posible comenzar incorporando una: No. You can start by adding one activity to a lesson that is already planned. Ideally, however, you plan from the outset with cognitive-motor strategies built in as a teaching resource, so that movement serves the learning objective.
¿Cuánto tiempo de la clase requiere?: How much class time does it take?
Son actividades breves, integradas al co: The activities are short and built into the content being taught, so they do not take time away from the curriculum.
¿Cómo logro que todos participen?: How do I get everyone to participate?
¿Qué hago si un estudiante no quiere par: What if a student does not want to participate?
Las actividades ofrecen opciones de part: The activities offer flexible ways to take part. A student can start in a different role, such as keeping score or giving the signal, and join the movement when they feel comfortable.
¿Sirve para estudiantes con distintas ne: Does it work for students with different needs and levels?
Sí. Cada actividad se adapta al grupo, a: Yes. Each activity is adapted to the group, the learning objectives, and special educational needs, with difficulty variations and specific supports.
¿Cómo sé que mis estudiantes aprenden?: How do I know my students are learning?
¿Cómo se asegura que el movimiento enseñ: How do you make sure movement teaches and is not just playtime?
Cada actividad tiene un propósito pedagó: Every activity has an explicit teaching purpose. Movement is used to teach, practice, or reinforce content, which is then consolidated through exercises and problems, individually or in groups, using a notebook, a textbook, or another resource of the teacher's choice.
¿Cómo evalúo a cada estudiante en activi: How do I assess each student in group activities?
La actividad grupal se complementa con i: Group activities are complemented by individual opportunities, such as observation with checklists, brief records, and written exercises that show what each student achieved.
¿En qué se diferencia de un taller depor: How is it different from a traditional sports program?
En un taller tradicional las tareas suel: In a traditional program, tasks tend to be routine, with fixed rules and a focus on technique. In a cognitively enriched program, the rules change and participants must make decisions, anticipate what others will do, and adapt to what happens during the activity. They train the sport and, at the same time, functions such as inhibition, working memory, and cognitive flexibility.
¿Qué necesito para implementarlo?: What do I need to implement it?
Un espacio deportivo escolar y los mater: A school sports space and the usual equipment for each discipline, such as balls, cones, and hoops. Each school sets the group size according to safety conditions, available materials, facilities, and the teacher's capacity to lead the activities.
Puede conducirlo un profesional de las c: It can be led by a professional in rehabilitation sciences, physical education, or other health or education fields, with experience leading physical activity with children in school or after-school settings. Each manual describes the activities with their objectives, organization, and materials, and the COGNI-move team offers training on how to apply them.
¿Cómo es una sesión?: What does a session look like?
Dura 90 minutos y se organiza en cuatro: It lasts 90 minutes and is organized into four phases (warm-up, main activity, competition in an adapted format, and cool-down). During the cool-down, the group reflects on what they did and the strategies they used. The length of each phase can be adjusted to the group and the setting.
¿Cómo avanza el programa en el tiempo?: How does the program progress over time?
Sport+EF (balonmano, fútbol o atletismo): Sport+EF (handball, soccer, or track and field) has 36 sessions over 12 weeks, with three sessions per week, organized into three four-week levels (basic, intermediate, and advanced). Each level adds learning situations that build skills gradually, from individual tasks to situations of greater complexity and interaction.
¿Cómo ajusto la dificultad a mi grupo?: How do I adjust the difficulty for my group?
Cada actividad ofrece variantes que modi: Each activity offers variations that change the rules, the space, or the playing conditions, so it can be adapted to each group and made easier or more challenging. The goal is to keep every participant facing an achievable challenge.
¿Qué pasa con quienes tienen menos habil: What about participants with lower motor skills or who don't enjoy competing?
El trabajo en parejas y grupos favorece: Working in pairs and groups encourages collaboration, and the emphasis is on deciding and solving, not just winning. That way, every participant can contribute to the game from their own strengths.
El espacio se revisa antes de cada sesió: The space is checked before each session, equipment is suited to the participants' age, and pairs or groups are formed in a balanced way. In addition, each activity specifies its own safety measures. Every session starts and ends with range-of-motion exercises.
Sí. Las actividades se plantean como jue: Yes. Activities are framed as games and challenges with changing rules and motivating goals, so they keep the fun that is part of sport.
¿Cómo sé que funciona?: How do I know it works?
¿Se pierde exigencia física al sumar des: Does adding cognitive challenges reduce the physical demand?
No. Las sesiones se desarrollan en inten: No. Sessions are carried out at moderate to vigorous intensity, and at the end of each one participants report their perceived exertion using the EPInfant children's scale, validated in the Chilean population.
¿Cómo registro el avance del grupo?: How do I track the group's progress?
Cada manual incluye un registro de sesió: Each manual includes a session log in which the teacher records observations and any adverse events. It also includes interim assessments of discipline-specific skills and of performance in practice situations, which give the teacher information on participants' progress and allow them to make the adjustments they consider necessary.
¿Sirve para otros deportes?: Does it work for other sports?
Sí. Los principios del modelo pueden apl: Yes. The model's principles can be applied to different sports. It is currently implemented in handball, soccer, track and field, and multi-sport.

Un modelo aplicado que integra de forma: An applied model that intentionally builds cognitive challenge into physical activity. Its cognitive-motor strategies, grounded in the evidence on cognitively enriched physical activity, strengthen executive functions, learning, and motor performance from early childhood through adulthood, in any institution where learning is the path to performing better and functioning effectively in everyday life.
Investigación y proyectos de Cognición e: Cognición en Movimiento research and projects
Proyectos de investigación científica y: Scientific research and implementation projects on cognitively enriched physical activity and executive functions, carried out at different stages of life together with partner institutions in a range of settings.
Estrategia cognitivo-motora que integra: A cognitive-motor strategy that blends movement and learning into short activities inside the classroom, with a clear teaching purpose and interdisciplinary design. It uses low-cost materials that can be adapted to each setting.
Formación docente y acompañamiento en la: Teacher training and support for implementing cognitive-motor strategies. We help rehabilitation science professionals, teachers, instructors, and institutions bring Cognición en Movimiento to their own setting, in Chile and abroad.
